summary: Backend regression tests for the WhatsApp-failed Bulk Reprocess fix. Injected 5 stub bills covering all edge cases into the preview DB, ran /api/admin/bills/bulk-reprocess (real async job) and polled its status until completion. All 6 features validated end-to-end via pytest.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 8259 lines — should be modularized (splits: bills, admin, reprocess, whatsapp, tagnpay client, auth).
_reprocess_single_bill is ~340 lines with many branches — extract Fundle handoff, force-credit, and image-download into helpers to reduce cyclomatic complexity.

The 'no_image' bucket is initialized correctly in both bulk_reprocess_bills and _run_bulk_reprocess_job; however summary[action] = summary.get(action, 0) + 1 will still silently create new buckets if a new action string is introduced elsewhere — consider a strict whitelist assertion in tests.
image_download_error truncated to 120 chars is fine; consider persisting it on the bill doc (e.g., image_download_error field) for admin visibility rather than only in rejection_reason.
seed_data_creation: 5 TEST-BR-* bills inserted into db.bills via pymongo covering: (1) empty image_url, (2) 404 HTTP image, (3) data:image with broken 1px JPEG (OCR fails), (4) amount=1500 + no bill_no + data:image, (5) user_id drift with 10-digit phone. All cleaned up in fixture teardown. Test user 919876543210 kept as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_reprocess_whatsapp_failed.py. Requires admin creds + local MongoDB access (mongodb://localhost:27017, db=test_database). Tests confirm: no_image bucket present in job summary; empty/404 image => action='no_image' with descriptive reason; data:image + failed OCR => manual_review; amount>0 + no bill_no => synthetic 'WA-*' bill_no persisted with synthetic_bill_no=True and NOT skipped; user_id drift falls back to user_phone lookup successfully; zero bills returned action='skipped'. Frontend Bills.jsx already renders no_image counter (lines 475, 1279, 1295) — not tested in this backend-only run.
rca of the issue: Original bug: bills with rejection_reason='WhatsApp bill processing failed:...' were returning action='skipped' from _reprocess_single_bill because (a) re_ocr flag was False by default, (b) empty/broken image_url short-circuited to skipped, (c) missing bill_no after OCR sent bills straight to manual_review. Fix layers verified: auto-force re_ocr when rejection_reason matches WhatsApp/OCR-fail pattern; new no_image action bucket distinguishes missing-image from OCR-failed-on-image; synthetic WA-{first8} bill_no lets Fundle receive a valid payload when amount extracted but bill_no missing; phone fallback (91XXX / 10-digit) rescues user_id drift. All paths return an actionable action instead of 'skipped'.
